node.title: BAND CHILD 2 (RH-AC): locate the rate-half adjacent crossing a_RH(q) at the razor rows within the proved bracket
node.statement: DECOMPOSITION CHILD 2 of rate_half_band_closure (2026-08-09, user-directed; plan notes/band_decomposition_plan_20260809.md). THE POSE OF RECORD (RH-AC), adopted from the round-27 draft with the decomposition ratification: at every admissible razor row (n = 2^41, k = 2^40, q prime in (2^255.9, 2^256), q = 1 mod n), locate the exact adjacent crossing a_RH(q) of (RH-ADJ) — B_mca(a_RH) <= B*(q) = floor(q/2^128) < B_mca(a_RH - 1) — within the PROVED bracket a_RH in [k + 2^34, 3n/4]. The binding term is S_sparse ALONE: B_ca^far is free at razor rows (B* ~ 2^128 >> n, the Hankel layer discharges the far-CA half), so the open content is exactly min{a : S_sparse(a) <= B*}. NO RANDOM-WORD QUANTITY MAY APPEAR IN THE STATEMENT (the round-27 forced correction: FLOOR v2 fell to its own falsifier via the max-vs-mean type error). Named candidate endpoints, NO discriminating evidence held: (RH-AC-lo) a_RH = k + 2^34 (the quotient floor is tight) vs (RH-AC-hi) a_RH = 3n/4 (the half-distance pincer HD1 is tight); the determined-region ratio extrapolation (~2^38.9, near -hi) is a heuristic across a mechanism change, labelled as such. KNOWN STRUCTURE AT CREATION (round 27): the lower end is counting-exhausted (the next floor rung is 11.87 bits short with a provably tight normalizer; the conversion goes lossless as q grows; counting cannot cross n/log2 q); the upper end is gated by residual budget 2^39+1, itself diagnosed to the unit (one slope past the provable incidence limit; evidence-grade TRUE on the forced prime-field axis; proof needs the APOLAR ORIGIN); closing that budget extends the bracket top from q >= 2^169 to all q > 2^167. The supply-side flank is censused (THEOREM CAP slack-0-scoped; the arbitrary-word maximum's scaling is the one undetermined number, decided by the named Modal-class n=32 maxscan).
node.falsifier: Pre-registered (round 27, with power controls): F1 — push the quotient-remainder floor's razor reach beyond 2^34 - 1 (high power: the constant moved 2^33 -> 2^34 in one wave; fires against (RH-AC-lo)). F2 — exhibit one received word y and razor row with N(y, k + 2^34; q) > floor(q/2^128) (fires against (RH-AC-lo) from the safe side). F3 — ZERO-POWER DECLARATION: any random-word or window-law count check at q < 2^128 has NO power over this pose (it measures the mean object; this is the guard that would have prevented the FLOOR v2 mis-banking).
